dishes.name: Simple Scrambled Eggs on Toast
dishes.title: Scrambled eggs on buttered toast
dishes.method: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt. Melt a small knob of butter in a pan over medium heat and scramble the eggs until just set. Serve on toasted bread.
dishes.why: A simple, warm start for Marceau that avoids the oven entirely.

dishes.name: Sunflower Seed Butter on Toast
dishes.title: Sunflower seed butter on crisp toast
dishes.method: Toast the bread until golden and spread generously with sunflower seed butter while still warm.
dishes.why: Substituted sunflower seed butter for the requested pistachio butter to protect the medical tree nut allergy constraint.

dishes.name: Spinach and Scrambled Egg Bowl
dishes.title: Scrambled eggs with wilted spinach
dishes.method: Sauté the spinach in oil until wilted, then pour in the whisked eggs and scramble until firm. Serve in a bowl without starch.
dishes.why: A high-protein, starch-free breakfast for Ysoline that avoids her fennel restriction.

dishes.name: Seared Chicken and Potato Plate
dishes.title: Pan-seared chicken with new potatoes and green beans
dishes.method: Place the chicken, potatoes, and beans in a wide frying pan with a splash of water. Cover and heat for 8 minutes until steaming hot.
dishes.why: Uses the hob-cooked batch to provide a warm, balanced lunch without needing the broken oven.

dishes.name: Hearty Chicken and Potato Plate
dishes.title: Large portion of seared chicken and potatoes with beans
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, potatoes, and beans in a pan over medium heat. Ensure the chicken is piping hot throughout.
dishes.why: Delivers the larger protein and starch shares Bertille needs for muscle gain.

dishes.name: Chicken and Garlic Bean Plate
dishes.title: Seared chicken with extra green beans
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken and beans in a pan. Add only half the potato portion from the box to the plate.
dishes.why: Prioritises vegetables and protein for Ysoline while keeping the starch portion small.

dishes.name: Lemon Chicken and Smashed Potatoes
dishes.title: Warm chicken and smashed potatoes with lemon
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken and potatoes in a pan. Once hot, lightly crush the potatoes with a fork and squeeze over fresh lemon juice.
dishes.why: A warm, comforting dinner that uses the same prep in a new texture.

dishes.name: Large Lemon Chicken and Potato Smash
dishes.title: Double portion of chicken and smashed potatoes
dishes.method: Reheat the full box of chicken and potatoes. Smash the potatoes and finish with lemon and a pinch of salt.
dishes.why: Fueling muscle gain with a warm, high-starch dinner for Bertille.

dishes.name: Warm Lemon Chicken and Beans
dishes.title: Seared chicken and green beans with lemon
dishes.method: Reheat chicken and green beans in a pan. Serve with a squeeze of lemon and no potatoes.
dishes.why: A warm, fennel-free dinner for Ysoline focusing on protein and the loud vegetable.

preparations.title: Pan-Seared Chicken Thighs
preparations.method: Season the chicken. Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Sear chicken for 6-8 minutes per side until cooked through and golden. Let rest before boxing.

preparations.title: Steamed New Potatoes
preparations.method: Halve any large potatoes. Boil in salted water for 15-20 minutes until tender. Drain and allow to steam dry before boxing.

preparations.title: Garlicky Green Beans
preparations.method: Trim the beans. Sauté in oil with minced garlic for 5-7 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the potatoes boiling first. While they cook, sear the chicken thighs in a large pan. Once the potatoes are draining, use a separate pan to sauté the garlicky green beans. Box everything into the named containers once cooled.

member_portions.portion_note: Serve the full box of chicken and potatoes for lunch and dinner; add extra toast at breakfast.

preparation_shares.note: Full portion for muscle gain fuel.

member_portions.portion_note: Serve half of the contents of each box for a child-sized plate.
Serve the full box of chicken and beans; omit or limit potatoes to a few pieces.
